ownership.publisher_incarnation: SGLang owns a random 16-byte ID per ZmqEventPublisher instance, stable across challenges. READY carries this ID; neither MP incarnation nor native sequence alone substitutes for it.
ownership.dynamo_native_listener: Optional zmq_replay_endpoint and zmq_replay_handshake enter the existing listener. It pins publisher incarnation, deduplicates native sequence before normalization/refcounts, repairs gaps with bounded replay, and withdraws the configured source on malformed/unavailable/truncated replay. Existing native parser preserves CPU/GPU medium; routing placement logic is unchanged.
ownership.independent_observer: The persistent observer reconnects through native socket monitor events and replays from zero. READY incarnation preserves the dedup cursor on same-publisher reconnect and resets it on publisher replacement. Accepted raw frames retain delivery=live/replay, connection and publisher_incarnation provenance.
ownership.lmcache_mp: MP still owns committed CPU residency and bounded MP event delivery. Native transport readiness adds no MP residency transition, hash recomputation or STORE fallback.

limitations: Declared scope is dense text-only full attention, private CPU/L1, LMCache-driven transfers, TP1/TP2 with DP=PP=1 and C divisible by B. Unsupported event-enabled profiles are rejected.
vLLM receives idle removals but publishes on engine steps. Five-second ordinary-idle and paused-child windows remain LIMITATION; separately measured active convergence passed.

vLLM MP restart recovery requires an observed unhealthy-to-healthy heartbeat edge and verification of every transfer registration plus subscription before inference. A short restart can miss that edge.

SGLang heartbeat does not restore transfer registrations. After MP replacement, observe old CPU withdrawal, restart the engine and refresh discovery before new inference; this supported procedure passed A/B on the final replay runtime.
MP replay is bounded and has no snapshot. Truncated history may leave physically warm prefixes undiscovered; the tested cold subscriber did not invent them.
The SGLang thin image requires exact read-only NVMe runtime directories for flashinfer_cubin and nvidia, with the exported manifest. The image alone is not a standalone deployment artifact.

Initial FlashAttention PTX JIT caused timeout diagnostics. Persistent CUDA caches and recorded setup warmup address compilation latency; no scheduler/backend change was used. Setup time is excluded from measured inference.
Overhead is one concurrency-one targeted profile with fixed debug/trace settings, measuring combined native GPU and MP CPU event overhead. It is not a general throughput or router-performance claim.
Metadata memory is filtered Python allocation evidence; the post-clear publication barrier can create a fresh live binding/chunk. Private Device-DAX hardware was not exercised.

Optional native SGLang replay is separately bounded: unavailable/truncated native history or publisher-incarnation changes terminate the listener and withdraw its source. Final live warm-engine replay passed A/B; an undetectable final PUB-frame loss remains a transport limitation.

SGLang ordinary idle eviction converged without inference on the final runtime; pausing scheduler/model children prevents subscriber reception and native publication during the five-second window. Post-resume active convergence passed A/B.
